stories.title: Collapsed glacier likely caused devastating Nepal-Tibet floods, scientists say
stories.body: Preliminary investigations by scientists have pointed to a collapsed glacier as the cause, highlighting the issue of rapidly melting Himalayan ice.

stories.title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
stories.body: Hundreds have died or are missing in Wednesday's flooding and landslides on the border of Nepal and Tibet.

stories.title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
stories.body: He was jailed for life in 2017 for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity during the wars in the ex-Yugoslavia in 1992-95.

stories.title: Jury deliberating in trial of Lindsay Clancy, US woman accused of killing her children
stories.body: Prosecutors argued Clancy made a calculated decision to murder the children, while the defence argued that she was suffering from postpartum psychosis.

stories.title: Norwegians lay flowers at palace as King Harald's condition worsens
stories.body: The 89-year-old's condition is described as "extremely serious" and members of his family have visited him in hospital.

stories.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
stories.body: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.

stories.title: Two killed in 'domestic violence incident' at school near Berlin
stories.body: Police have arrested a 19-year-old male suspect after an incident in which two people were killed near the German capital.

stories.title: Man who attacked nun on CCTV in Jerusalem acquitted on grounds of mental health
stories.body: A Jerusalem court said the Jewish attacker was having a psychotic episode when he assaulted the nun, in an incident which caused outrage.

stories.title: Thieves steal Bronze Age artefacts from Spanish museum in four-minute heist
stories.body: The Treasure of Villena is a unique trove of almost ten kilos of gold, bowls, bottles and bracelets dating back to the Bronze Age.

stories.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
stories.body: Trump's order comes after the trade talks between the US and Canada collapsed late last week.

stories.title: Optimus Prime and Eeyore voice actor Peter Cullen dies
stories.body: Cullen voiced the heroic Optimus Prime in the Transformers TV series and then the Hollywood films.

stories.title: Jellyfish force partial shutdown of French nuclear plant
stories.body: It is the second consecutive year that jellyfish has forced the closure of the Gravelines power station in northern France.

stories.title: Allan Little: I met dangerously fanatical Mladić early in Bosnian war
stories.body: BBC special correspondent Allan Little met the "Butcher of Bosnia" in the early months of the Bosnian war.

stories.title: 'The flood took everything': Nepal survivors describe horror of loved ones being swept away
stories.body: One woman says her father, mother, sister and sister's children were carried away before her eyes.

stories.title: What we should make of CIA boss's secret trip to Moscow
stories.body: There is nothing routine about John Ratcliffe making a secret, 10,000-mile return dash to Moscow, writes Frank Gardner.

stories.title: Key moments in trial of Lindsay Clancy, the mother accused of murdering her three children
stories.body: A jury is deliberating in the trial of the Massachusetts mother charged with murdering her three small children

stories.title: Tracing the deadly path of the Nepal-Tibet flash flood
stories.body: BBC Verify traces the path of the destructive Nepal-Tibet flash flood using verified video.

stories.title: What caused the Nepal-Tibet flash floods?
stories.body: At least 270 people have died in the massive flash floods, while more than 800 others are missing.

stories.title: People pulled from mud in Nepal after deadly flash floods
stories.body: At least 160 people have been killed along the Nepal-Tibet border as rescuers struggle to reach the disaster zone.

stories.body: This video has been edited by the BBC with white flashes, due to the distressing content.
